build_VoteModule: build a VoteModule instance with custom in_channels, vote_per_seed, and conv_channels for 3D point cloud voting
run_VoteModule_forward: run VoteModule forward pass with seed_points and seed_feats tensors to generate vote points and features
run_VoteModule_get_loss: run VoteModule get_loss to calculate weighted vote loss from seed points, vote points, and ground truth targets
review_VoteModule_forward: review VoteModule forward method to understand how offsets are computed and vote_xyz_range clamping works
refactor_VoteModule_norm_feats: refactor VoteModule to toggle norm_feats flag for enabling or disabling L2 normalization on voted features
